images.alt: Gold's divergence challenges a uniform dollar account. The review attributes WTI's move against equities to Hormuz supply risk, without independently confirming that geopolitical premise. Its conditional oil thesis needs the contracting range to break upward.

posts.text: Capital Chronicle's oil thesis needs a range break; its euro reading retains rates and positioning countercases, while gold tests the dollar link. Watch: The review says gold made no lower low and had stopped following the dollar leg.
